title: GPT-3.5, GPT-4, or BARD? Evaluating LLMs Reasoning Ability in Zero-Shot Setting and Performance Boosting Through Prompts
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating various reasoning abilities of LLMs (deductive, inductive, abductive, mathematical, commonsense, causal, multi-hop) through question-answering tasks. It does not contain sections or experiments dedicated to benchmarking or evaluating religion, morals, or ethics. While 'mitigating biases' and 'producing safer content' are mentioned as LLM design goals, the paper itself does not perform such an evaluation.
